attributes.Definition: Information used to identify and contact a customer: email address, name, phone number and postal address.
attributes.Legal Basis: Storage limitation under fictional policy FW-RET-001

attributes.Definition: Personal details beyond contact information collected for the loyalty program, such as a customer's date of birth.
attributes.Legal Basis: Data minimisation under fictional policy FW-RET-002

attributes.Definition: Partial payment card details and billing information captured when a customer pays, such as card last four digits and billing postal code.
attributes.Legal Basis: Card scheme dispute window under fictional policy FW-RET-003

attributes.Definition: Records of a customer's contact with the support desk, including ticket subject, message content and requester details.
attributes.Legal Basis: Service quality and complaint handling under fictional policy FW-RET-004

attributes.Definition: Browsing activity on the Fernwood website: sessions, page views, device and network identifiers such as IP address.
attributes.Legal Basis: Consent-based analytics under fictional policy FW-RET-005

attributes.Definition: Marketing engagement data where the customer identifier has been replaced by a one-way hash. Proposed concept; retention policy not yet agreed.
Campaign setup and performance data: channels, budgets, sends, opens, clicks and attributed revenue.
attributes.Legal Basis: Marketing performance records under fictional policy FW-RET-006

attributes.Definition: Orders, order lines, returns, amounts and revenue figures generated by customer purchases online and in store.
attributes.Legal Basis: Tax and accounting record keeping under fictional policy FW-RET-007

attributes.Definition: Product catalog attributes and stock levels by warehouse. No retention policy applies to this concept.
Information used to contact an employee: name, work email and personal email.
attributes.Legal Basis: Employment records under fictional policy FW-RET-008

attributes.Definition: Salary and other pay details for an employee.
attributes.Legal Basis: Payroll record keeping under fictional policy FW-RET-009

attributes.Definition: Key dates and facts of an employee's employment, such as joining date, termination date and department.
attributes.Legal Basis: Employment history and pension claims under fictional policy FW-RET-010

attributes.Definition: Government-issued identifiers held for employees, such as the last four digits of a national ID number.
attributes.Legal Basis: Statutory employer reporting under fictional policy FW-RET-011

attributes.Definition: A person with a Fernwood account who has placed at least one order online or in store.
A customer who has placed an order in the last 365 days.
Total net revenue from a customer to date, plus predicted net revenue over the next 12 months.
A confirmed purchase of one or more products by a customer, online or in store.
Order value before discounts, refunds and returns, excluding tax and shipping.
Gross revenue minus discounts, refunds and returns, excluding tax and shipping.
Net revenue divided by the number of orders in a period.
A customer request to return one or more items from an order for refund or exchange. Draft definition pending finance review.
A loyalty program member's level (Trail, Summit, Peak), based on 12-month spend.
A customer's recorded consent to receive marketing email. Customers without opt-in must not be included in marketing audiences.
A group of opted-in customers selected for a marketing campaign, e.g. 'high value lapsed'.
Credit for an order given to the last campaign the customer clicked within 7 days before ordering.
Unique clicks divided by delivered emails for a campaign.
Units sold in a period divided by units available at the start of the period.
Units on hand divided by average weekly units sold over the last 4 weeks.
Minutes between a support ticket being created and the first agent reply.
Any information relating to an identified or identifiable person, customer or employee. Classified at column level; only reviewed and confirmed classifications count.
Personal information where direct identifiers are replaced, e.g. by a one-way hash. Still treated as personal information.
A source or mart table with an active data contract, a reviewed PI decision on every column, and an approved Data Category.
How long data must be kept after a trigger event before it is deleted, anonymized or archived. Recorded on the Data Category that the table resolves to.
